create_sample_hdf5: run the script to create a sample HDF5 file with EMG and joint angle timeseries data
create_test_data: create a test HDF5 file containing 100 timesteps of random EMG and joint angle data
run_create_test_hdf5: run the script to generate test_data.hdf5 with emg2pose group and metadata attributes
review_create_a_sample_hdf5_file: review the create_a_sample_hdf5_file function that builds structured numpy arrays and writes them to HDF5
summarize_create_a_sample_hdf5_file: summarize the create_a_sample_hdf5_file function that generates synthetic EMG pose estimation test data
